## About
Lightning Fast Electrical Automotive Repair LLC is a state of Michigan licensed facility in Dearborn that focuses on one thing: diagnosing and repairing automotive electrical systems on passenger cars, SUVs and light duty trucks, including Ford, GM, Chrysler, Honda and more.
The equipment here is OEM diagnostic software and hardware, scan tools and factory service manuals, capable of complete dealership level diagnostic testing and repair. Only OEM original equipment and parts go into your vehicle. No aftermarket installs.
Reviewers talk about Vince by name. One said he was "completely open, honest, and thorough," and another said he saved them time and money compared to the dealership. The shop holds a 5 rating from 71 Google reviews.

## Services
- Diagnostic Troubleshooting/Repair of automotive electrical systems: Check engine light, powertrain malfunction indicator light, trouble codes, SRS airbag, factory anti-theft, TPMS, emissions, starting, charging and network communication systems.
- Module Replacement/Program/Flash: Module troubleshooting, replacement and reprogramming/flashing. ($125.00 hr.)
- Powertrain Diagnostics and Testing: For Ford, Lincoln and Mercury vehicles with a check engine light, rough running or stalling. Ford IDS runs Misfire Monitor, Power Balance, Relative Compression, Relative Injector Flow and Fuel Pump Leak Down testing. Additional fees may apply depending on equipment or software needed. (Call for Pricing)
- NVH (Noise,Vibrations,Harshness) Analysis and Testing: For Ford, Lincoln and Mercury cars, SUVs and trucks with a noise or vibration you feel at certain speeds through the seat, steering wheel or pedals. These can come from suspension and driveline issues. ($75.00 hr.)
- Vehicle Electrical System Diagnostic Health Report: A complete bumper to bumper report on your vehicle's electrical system, with professional consultation on repairs and cost at your request. ($125.00)
- TPMS Sensor Diagnosis & Digital Tire Tread Inspection: Diagnostic troubleshooting and maintenance on TPMS sensors, plus a digital tire tread wear report on the overall condition of your tires.
- Programming keys, Immobilizer codes and Immobilizer resets: Key fob and keyless entry diagnosis, key programming and immobilizer work. Ownership documentation is required.
- Parasitic Battery Drain Issues: Tracking down what is draining your battery overnight, along with batteries, starters, alternators, wiring issues and shorts that blow fuses.

## FAQ
Q: Can I just drop in?
A: No. You must schedule an appointment before service can be provided, and customers are scheduled on a first call, first service basis. Call Vince to book a time.

Q: Which vehicles do you work on?
A: Passenger cars, SUVs and light duty trucks from 2008 to the current model year, including Acura/Honda, Audi/Volkswagen, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Chrysler, Dodge, Fiat, Ford/Mercury/Lincoln, GMC, Hyundai/Kia, Nissan/Infiniti, Jeep, Mazda, Toyota and Volvo. For vehicles earlier than 2008, contact us to ask.

Q: What do I need to bring for key or security system work?
A: Ownership documentation: your title, registration and Michigan driver's license.

Q: How can I pay?
A: Cash, credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX) and digital wallets including Apple Pay, Google Pay and Cash App.
